title: Set protective attributes on session cookies
summary: Cookies that carry sessions or other credentials must be inaccessible to page scripts, sent only over HTTPS, and limited in cross-site use.
review_checks: Find where session and auth cookies are set, including framework settings.
Check the HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite attributes and the cookie scope (domain and path).
safe_tests: Inspect Set-Cookie headers from a local or test instance and confirm HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite are present.
Confirm document.cookie in the browser does not expose the session cookie.
remediation: Set HttpOnly and Secure on credential cookies and choose SameSite=Lax or Strict.
Scope cookies to the narrowest domain and path, and rotate the session identifier after login.
